# @vllnt/convex-reactions

> Reactions, votes, and likes on any resource — toggle, count by kind, and list reactors as a Convex component

`@vllnt/convex-reactions` is a publishable Convex component. It targets `convex@^1.45.0`.
It stores sandboxed tables - `reactions` (a reaction edge `{ authorRef, resourceRef, kind, createdAt }`: an opaque host subject reacted to an opaque host resource with one reaction `kind` - an emoji, `up`/`down`, `like`) and `reactionCounts` (one tally per resource and kind). A host mutation calls `react(authorRef, resourceRef, kind)` to toggle the edge (insert if absent, delete if present) in one transaction and gets back `{ reacted, action }`; `unreact(authorRef, resourceRef, kind)` removes it idempotently. One edge per subject per kind per resource is enforced inside the mutation transaction, so toggles and counts stay correct under concurrency. Queries: `counts(resourceRef)` reads one stored tally row per kind kept in step by react/unreact (a resource whose edges predate tallies is counted from its edges), `reactors(resourceRef, kind, paginationOpts)` pages who reacted oldest-first with bounded Convex pagination (`numItems` 1 through 1000, `maximumRowsRead` capped at 1000, invalid numeric options throw `INVALID_PAGE_SIZE`), `hasReacted` and `myReactions` expose a subject's own state. `createdAt` is read from the server clock inside the handler - no caller-supplied clock. The reaction vocabulary is configurable: `new Reactions(component, { allowedKinds })` rejects an unknown kind with a plain Error for react/unreact only, not queries or direct component calls. A repeated react toggles the edge back; it is not retry-idempotent. The host owns the subject, the resource, the vocabulary, and auth (opaque refs - the component never de-references them or reads host tables); the component owns only the reaction edges and their per-kind tallies. Mount-safe: it runs correctly under multiple named `app.use` mounts.

## For coding agents

The docs are bundled at `node_modules/@vllnt/convex-reactions/docs/` and match the installed version, as do `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and the TypeScript source in `src/`. Read them before writing code.

Ecosystem: [vllnt oss](https://oss.vllnt.com/llms.txt) indexes every `@vllnt` package.

Repository files, not in the npm package; they follow `main`.
